state_contract_common.reads: FView only (Active, Step, Committed[6], HeldStep, HeldMs, FailedStripSerial/AgeMs, LastAction); it never advances a hold, credits a unit or imposes a cooldown
state_contract_common.Idle: not Active, or not admitted at the station: the station's props in Committed's state, the paws free
state_contract_common.Ready: admitted (b09_craft_region.admitted), the step active, not held: the paws in the first working pose of the next unit, after its preparation clip
state_contract_common.Held: HeldStep == the step: the pose and props are a function of HeldMs alone
state_contract_common.Committed: Committed[step] advanced: the completion clip, then Ready for the next unit or the next step
state_contract_common.Cancelled: a timed hold ends uncredited (early release, ineligible, or a bend outside 640-960 ms): the presenter returns to Ready from where it is; work already shown by contact stays shown
state_contract_common.Retry: the next press after the release (root's WaitRelease): HeldMs restarts at 0
state_contract_common.press_steps: steps 2, 4, 5 are credited at the press; their clip is a function of LastAction.AgeMs for the matching Step and Unit; leaving, crouching or combat mid-clip only stops presenting it (nothing rolls back, nothing to retry); a reset or reload clears the record and the presenter's cursor

inspect_decision: Coordination 277: the single Inspect unit checks the three completed festival shells' fuse cords (FuseCheck3 to FuseCheck1); nothing is lit, loaded or discharged; recipe counts, timing, reward and b10's charge fuse are unchanged; weapon 7 stays visibly supported in its block, clear of the hand path. A presentation decision, not a contact-gate waiver
collision: every mesh is visual only; root keeps or replaces its boxes with the proposed proxies. Each proxy is under the standing station trace's 88 cm start, so no standing ray meets one. That covers the standing capsule only: crouched (half-height 44) the trace starts at 44 cm, and proxy tops of 75-78 cm can block close crouched approaches, as today's generic benches can. Crouched and native coverage are root's

state_contract.Ready: hoop n+1 prepared (about 900 ms): the right paw takes the top layer's right-hand strip end (StripStock), lifts it out and carries it round the form's right to the notch and hooks it (the left paw waits off the form at WindSteady{n+1}); then the left comes in to press the hooked strip (WindPress{n+1}) as the right slides out along it to the guide (WindGuide{n+1})
state_contract.Held: HeldMs 0-800: the strip at flex_stage(HeldMs), the form turned by form_yaw_deg(n, flex), the needle at gauge_angle(HeldMs); the left paw presses, the right holds the free strip as it draws through its grip
state_contract.Committed: Committed[0] = n+1: the hoop seats; the right paw lets the strip's end go into its lap; the next hoop's preparation follows (none after hoop 6)
state_contract.Cancelled: a release outside 640-960 ms or an early release: the split strip at SplitStripRest while FailedStripAgeMs < SPLIT_SHOW_MS, then a fresh strip's preparation
state_contract.timing_conflict: a re-press sooner than the preparation's ~900 ms after a commit or a split cuts the preparation short; with no cooldown the presenter must blend from where the paws are to the Held pose (measured, to be agreed with root)

state_contract.kind: step 1 a timed hold (PasteMs 1500) per panel; step 2 a press
state_contract.Ready: panel n+1: the frame turned by panel_turn_deg(n + 1) so its seam faces the hero; the left paw has taken sheet n+1 by its near end from the rail (SheetTake); the brush dipped at PasteDip
state_contract.Held: HeldMs 0-400: the left paw lays the sheet on the frame (gore PASTE_ORDER[n], wrapping from the seam toward the hero's left) and holds it by its fingertips at SheetHold; the brush to the lower rim line. 400-1500: the stroke from the lower rim line to the upper (Seam_0..8), the bristle edge turned square at each rim line; paste only where the bristles have swept
state_contract.Committed: Committed[1] = n+1: the left paw lets go, the cradle turns the frame +90 deg, the left takes the next sheet and the brush re-dips (about 800 ms)
state_contract.Cancelled: an early release: after 400 ms the sheet stays laid and held with the paste swept so far, the brush back to the pot; before 400 ms the paw keeps the sheet and returns to Ready
state_contract.Retry: the stroke from the lower rim line again (already pasted washi stays as it is)
state_contract.timing_conflict: a re-press sooner than the completion's ~800 ms (turn, next sheet, re-dip) leaves that preparation unfinished; with no cooldown the presenter must compress it (measured, to be agreed with root)
state_contract.rims: step 2's press seats the top rim from RimTopRest on the upper mouth (RimTopSeat). Measured conflict: on the paste pose the upper mouth is out of reach (151 %); proposed: the cradle re-tilts the frame for the rims (a two-axis cradle bringing the upper mouth to the front, as PASTE_FIRST_POSE did)
state_contract.open: the stroke's last sample at the upper rim line: hidden behind the laid gore from some stands, and reach 98.1-99.8 % / wrist 76-78 deg at the far-left and near-right stands (b09_craft_region)
